name: charter
description: Agent skills for Charter, an open compute marketplace paid over x402 on Base: find an offer, open a lease, pay it by the interval and collect the job's output.

plugins.name: charter
plugins.description: Rent Charter compute over x402 in USDC on Base, with the charter CLI or any x402 client: read the offers and each host's record, open a lease, pay it by the interval and collect the output, or rent a home with a kept disk and SSH in. Hosts are run by independent operators.
